name: rustwake
blurb: Clear the rogue machines out of a dark plant.
about: Clear the rogue machines out of a dark plant, one map at a time.
facts: 12 maps. Five kinds of machine. One gun, so aim.
picture: A sketch of rustwake: a corridor, a door at its end, a drone, and your gun.
recording: rustwake playing itself: the overseer in Control fires three bolts at your gun.

name: skyspear
blurb: Cave people, dinosaurs and falling stars.
about: A prehistoric lost world, built and broken one block at a time: cave people among dinosaurs, fire mountains and falling stars.
facts: A world with no end, made from a seed.
picture: A sketch of skyspear: stepped land, a tree, a hunter with a spear, and a falling star.

name: breakshot
about: Eight-ball pool. Practice alone, share a keyboard, or play a friend online with a room code.
facts: Press V and the camera flies down behind the cue ball.
picture: A sketch of breakshot: a pool table, the rack, the cue ball and where it is aimed.
